items.title: Scale to many tools with tool search
items.version: page as accessed; not a frozen deployed SDK version
items.read_scope: How tool search works, web-rendered lines 104–107; nearby overview and configuration context
items.claim: Official documentation describes an added search round trip and notes that a small comfortably fitting tool set may be faster when loaded upfront. This is a conditional vendor description, not a measured result for this project.
items.not_used: No tool-count optimal threshold, current product compatibility promise, or benchmark extrapolation is adopted.
